description:
You are a seismic risk analyst at a global reinsurance company. The underwriting team needs a country-level portfolio exposure report based on the past 30 days of seismic activity to inform their catastrophe model inputs.

The USGS real-time earthquake feed (M2.5+, last 30 days) and Natural Earth country boundaries have been downloaded to /home/ga/GIS_Data/. Perform a spatial aggregation to count earthquake epicenters per country and compute per-country magnitude statistics.

Input files:
- /home/ga/GIS_Data/earthquakes_month.geojson  (USGS M2.5+ earthquakes, last 30 days)
- /home/ga/GIS_Data/world_countries.geojson  (Natural Earth country boundaries with 'ADMIN' field for country name and 'ISO_A3' for ISO code)

Deliverable: /home/ga/GIS_Data/exports/country_seismic_exposure.geojson
- A GeoJSON FeatureCollection
- Include ONLY countries that experienced at least 1 earthquake epicenter within their boundary
- Each feature must retain the country geometry and original fields, plus exactly these four computed fields:
  * quake_count  (integer: count of earthquake epicenters whose centroid falls within the country boundary)
  * mean_mag     (float, 2 decimal places: arithmetic mean of all earthquake magnitudes in that country)
  * max_mag      (float: maximum magnitude of any earthquake in the country)
  * risk_tier    (string: 'low' if quake_count < 5, 'medium' if quake_count >= 5 and < 15, 'high' if quake_count >= 15)

Field names must be exactly as specified. Do not include countries with zero earthquakes.
